svg.title: A-411 Side & Rear Elevations — Scheme B “Arcade”
svg.text: LEVEL east, north and west · 1:75 @ A1 · METRES
External / party wall cut by section, 300 mm —
Single leaf door, swing shown to opening side
Glazed opening — arched head where noted
Element above the cut plane (pergola, slab
1. The exterior only. The plans, site plan and section are
agreed and re-issued to the adopted curve; nothing here
changes the rest of them: same five levels, same 9.50 ×
13.50 m footprint, same 1.00 m setbacks, same openings.
Only the skin differs between the schemes.
2. Every opening drawn here is read from the plan it belongs
to rather than redrawn, and checks.py fails the build if
an elevation ever shows one the plan does not have.
3. The east and north boundaries are open and carry ordinary
windows on every floor. The west is the blind elevation:
louvred ventilation only, drawn at high level, and nothing
4. The penthouse stands back 4.81 m from the west and 1.66 m
from the north, so on those two faces it is drawn in thin
line behind the roof terrace parapet.
5. The balcony appears on the street frontage only and so
does not show on any of these three faces.
Option not selected — scheme A “Wave” was adopted at P18. Record only; not for construction.
Do not scale; work to figured dimensions only.
P23 2026-10-10 services layouts: overlapping labels; ground floor re-centred
P24 2026-10-10 EL-400, ME-200 and PL-300 drawn back onto the sheet
P25 2026-10-10 interior cutaways drawn at 1:50, with the principal rooms named
P26 2026-10-11 A-401: the three ground lines no longer cross the frame or meet
